The application section says to work small areas of about 3 m2 at a time, leave at least an hour to dry, and that a second and a third coat can be applied if necessary in alternate directions, which is why the coats control runs to three.

kerakoll/supersoap.reason: The sheet quotes a coverage of approximately 10 g per square metre using a mop, and a dilution of about one measuring cap in 3 litres of water, but the pack is a 1.5 litre bottle. The sheet gives no density, so there is no published way to turn square metres into bottles of concentrate. Dilute one cap in 3 litres of water and work from the area a bucket covers on site.

kerakoll/top-latex.reason: The sheet gives no rate of its own. Under Coverage it says to see the dosages in the characteristics of the adhesive, because Top Latex replaces part of the mixing water of another product and the dose is set there. Sold in 25 kg and 8 kg cans.

pack.label: two component pail, A plus B

pidilite-puma/pegoland-elastic.caveat: Two component reaction resin adhesive, class R2T. The figures are for the mixed product. Note the sheet's own inconsistency: the coverage rows are quoted against a 4 kg pack while PACKAGING AND STORAGE gives an 8 Kg two component pail, so one pail is two of the printed units. The sheet also says coverage will vary depending on trowel notch size and type, tile size and how smooth and even the substrate is.
